rubric: protocol.md; scalar values 0 / 0.5 / 1. Correctness and completeness are frozen requested-point coverage, including failed cases as zero; contextual details not requested are not required. Citation and faithfulness units are factual claim groups (paragraph/bullet), not token counts. Missing-information claims are scored separately. Compound claim groups receive partial support when a material qualifier is unsupported. Citation support pools the cited passages for one claim; citation coverage requires a supporting inline citation on that claim group. Claim-free answers have no citation/faithfulness denominator; they still affect correctness, abstention and reliability.
review_scope: Six original financial case/arm answers. Original page 1 image was visually reviewed; every answer and actual supplied source body, table context, page region and supplement was inspected. Streamed deltas, final answer and saved answer were checked for identity. Provider/schema success is not used as semantic correctness.

grouping_decisions: Claim units remain factual paragraphs or bullets, not sentences or tokens. A trailing citation covers its own paragraph; a citation in a later bullet does not cover an earlier bullet.

The single apparent-conflict introductory framing repeats its scored final conclusion and is retained separately, excluded from the denominator exactly as in the historical review. Its absence of an inline citation is visible and does not silently change historical denominators.

Quarter/full-year and fiscal-Q4 wording is accepted as a reasonable inference from the same-ending three- and twelve-month financial periods. These are not verbatim source labels; no new calendar-day dates are inferred.
94.93 billion and rounded 391.04 billion are correct arithmetic conversions of 94,930 and 391,035 million. Extra conversions do not create additional requested gold points.

Historical apparent-conflict single was factually correct against the original page but cited income reconciliation that lacked sales figures. Those zero context/citation scores remain distinct from reference correctness 1.
Historical planned-income error remains in correctness/completeness denominators as zero; no answer claims means it has no faithfulness/citation claim denominator.
